notes: Fixes the reported bug where the drums stuck on the first look and ignored what later songs were programmed for. A controller whose preset storage is full drops saves without saying so; songs are now checked after saving, and a warning stays on screen when a controller is nearly full or did not take a song. Each controller's Presets button lists presets that are unused or old and deletes them in a couple of taps (backed up first). Reports filed as "Something is broken" now include a snapshot of the rig so the problem can be traced.
